inline_comments.comment: This should use a `mermaid-example` fenced block instead of a plain `mermaid` block. The docs build pipeline (`packages/mermaid/scripts/docs.mts`) transforms every `mermaid-example` block in the source into two output blocks — one `mermaid-example` (code view) and one `mermaid` (rendered diagram) — in the generated `docs/` tree. Using a plain `mermaid` block here bypasses that transformation, so the published docs will show only a raw rendered diagram with no code view. Change the opening fence from ` ```mermaid ` to ` ```mermaid-example `.

Editing the generated file directly means these changes will be silently overwritten the next time the build runs. The `mermaid-example` block here (line 993) is also evidence of a sync mismatch: the source file only contains a plain `mermaid` block, so running the build pipeline from the current source would produce a `mermaid`-only block in the output — discarding the `mermaid-example` block that was manually inserted here. Fix the source to use `mermaid-example`, regenerate, and drop the direct edits to this file.
